title: Aureline M5 reproducibility proof
description: Canonical per-domain proof for the release and emergency-hotfix build lanes. Names the verified or re-materialized inputs, the clean-room rebuild diff, the artifact classes converged on one exact build identity (binaries, packages, SBOMs, attestations, docs packs, schemas, symbols, rollback metadata, and support packets), and the exact-build supportability convergence so a remote-cache hit is never treated as reproducibility proof, sidecars stay pinned to the binary build identity, clean-room parity is never overclaimed on partial rebuilds, and non-hermetic inputs, cache poisoning, and unreplayable artifacts block promotion. Downstream release-center, shiproom, diagnostics, provenance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's reproducibility posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
